title: Promoter || Counter sales || ISP
description:
Role & responsibilities Welcome customers and understand their requirements and preferences. Demonstrate products and explain features, specifications, pricing, and benefits. Recommend suitable products based on customer needs and budget. Achieve monthly sales targets through effective customer engagement and conversion. Promote complementary products, accessories, and extended warranty plans. Handle billing coordination and assist customers throughout the purchase process. Maintain product displays, merchandising standards, and showroom cleanliness. Track stock availability and coordinate with the inventory team for replenishment. Resolve customer queries and provide excellent after-sales support. Stay updated on product launches, offers, and competitor products.
